_core: Draft chips for a form step, accepted one by one. Core decides which fields with its decision engine (one ask-or-skip choice per field the step does not ask yet) and has a writing model give the one-sentence reasons for the chips shown; without the decision engine the writing model does both. The answer has the same shape either way: at most 8 suggestions, best first, each a field key from `fields` not in `asked`.
